Gate-activation hypothesis

The gate activates on tokens expressing confidence, certainty, or positive assurance, such as "confident," "sure," "believe," "trust," and "good hands." It also fires on modal verbs like "will," "should," and "could" when used to predict successful outcomes or affirm capabilities, often in contexts of reassurance, self-belief, or professional competence.

Describes when the gate fires. It does not establish the transform’s causal output effect.
